interruptions.permitted: Only fix engineering errors unrelated to outcomes, such as IO, isolation, device/runtime compatibility, serialization or progress reporting, while preserving algorithms, trial set, mapping, constants and registered analyses.
interruptions.restart: After any engineering fix, invalidate current run artifacts as analysis inputs, retain them in a failure archive, and rerun the entire preregistered54-person×9-panel inference/calibration workflow from beginning; do not selectively retain successful persons or panels.
interruptions.after_scoring: Never modify rules or numerical constants after any score is seen. If an error affects validity after scoring, disclose it, archive the result as invalid and stop for a new plan and user confirmation rather than adjust based on score.
interruptions.logging: Record error, discovery phase, whether labels/scores had been opened, exact code diff and hashes, reason the fix is outcome-independent, complete-run identifiers.
